title: Peer-route maturity and artifact-freshness reconciliation
mode: Primary-source project, release, documentation, issue, and PR review
scope: Refresh open-source DWG/DXF peer routes across native codecs, derivatives, DXF projections, downstream CAD consumers, and bare ACIS interpreters.
Distinguish issue reports and open fixes from released/deployed artifacts, and record route-specific evidence ceilings.
Refine existing PAR-07/S8, PAR-20/7G.3, and composed consumer gates without creating duplicate work or promoting support claims.

sources.revision: Moving NEWS and issue pages reviewed 2026-10-20; issue names LibreDWG 0.14.8593 at commit 8a1ae764.
sources.observed: NEWS describes AcDsPrototype_1b/R2013+ SAB extraction as incomplete or heuristic; issue #1411 reports payload loss for a named build.
sources.limits: Peer project/issue evidence does not establish ODA wire layout, current-master behavior, libdxfrw behavior, or ACIS semantics.

sources.project: ACadSharp CP949 issue and proposed fix
sources.revision: Issue and PR pages reviewed 2026-10-20; report names ACadSharp 3.7.16 and 3.8.0; PR #1260 is open with one commit and no deployments.
sources.observed: The issue distinguishes code-page header token from payload bytes and shows both CP949-bytes/unknown-token and UTF-8-bytes/ANSI_949 as invalid pairings.
sources.limits: The PR is not a released fix or independent validation; the issue is a peer-authored report.

sources.revision: ACadRust v0.6.5 tag resolves to 289a616da6c68518218594aa80802cbe7fa71309; OpenCADStudio v2026.42 released 2026-10-18.
sources.observed: OpenCADStudio v2026.42 locks ACadRust 0.6.4; the separately tagged 0.6.5 package is not the codec in that application release. OpenCADStudio remains within the tracked ACadRust/ACadSharp-derived parser lineage.
sources.limits: No release binary hash was recorded or runtime executed; downstream app behavior cannot be attributed to a newer parser package.

sources.project: ezdxf DXF and bounded ACIS routes
sources.revision: Stable documentation reviewed 2026-10-20; entity pages identify version 1.4.5.
sources.observed: Unsupported entity tags may be retained in TagStorage; recovery/audit is an explicit route with lossy/invalid-output cautions; ACIS handling is limited and does not provide a general ACIS kernel.
sources.limits: Opaque tag retention, recovery success, and simple ACIS parsing are not typed or general semantic support and do not provide a DWG codec.

sources.observed: Binary DXF reading begins with GDAL 3.12; AC1027+ DXF_3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE can expose raw ASM data and a transform, while the driver does not create OGR solid geometry from these records and skips them by default.
sources.limits: OGR projection and raw-carrier exposure do not establish full CAD graph preservation, B-rep validity, or DWG AcDs association.

sources.revision: Public documentation and current source reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: DWG processing composes an external converter with a separately selected DXF importer; the documented C++ and optional legacy Python importer profiles differ, and stock FreeCAD documentation says ACIS/SAT solids cannot currently be read.
sources.limits: A converter result is not equivalent to FreeCAD object import or ACIS semantics; exact backend/build/settings must be pinned.

sources.revision: Current project documentation reviewed 2026-10-20; exact profile and lineage limitations are already tracked in PAR-07/S8 research.
sources.observed: These routes interpret extracted bare ACIS/ASM carriers rather than DWG/DXF container sections or AcDs ownership joins.
sources.limits: Only exact documented profiles and independently authored expected geometry can be assessed; parser, neutral topology transfer, kernel, and native consumer are separate evidence.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: classify each comparator as codec, derivative, projection, composed consumer, or geometry interpreter before interpreting its result.

PAR-07/S8: bind a candidate to exact release/commit, artifact hash, route, direction, version, semantic layer, source denominator, and diagnostics; do not transfer results between PR head, package, and downstream application pins.
PAR-20/7G.3: retain current NOD/owner-root implementation order; external peer states do not block generated local fast slices.
CP949: preserve the existing ASCII label-plus-literal-byte control; binary-output byte-level validation remains a distinct future gate.
Consumer qualification: record the FreeCAD converter and importer as separate stages, including backend and intermediate DXF identity.
Validation cadence: fast local selector and focused CTest per slice; optional pinned peer/native checks only at existing composed milestones.

planChanges: Added a compact cross-project route matrix distinguishing native codecs, derivatives, projections, composed application consumers, and bare geometry interpreters.
Recorded that ACadSharp CP949 PR #1260 is still open and undeployed; do not treat its proposed fix as a released peer result.
Recorded the OpenCADStudio v2026.42 to ACadRust 0.6.4 pin separately from ACadRust v0.6.5, preserving parser-lineage and artifact freshness boundaries.
Refined existing GDAL, FreeCAD, ezdxf, and ACIS comparator admission rules without adding dependencies, tests, fixtures, findings, or support claims.
Kept the local PAR-20/7G.3 fast implementation queue and reduced validation cadence unchanged; external unavailability remains self-unblocking.
limitations: Issue and project pages are not normative format specifications and may change after review.
No peer package or executable was installed, built, or run; no native CAD application or geometry kernel was run.
No external drawing or issue attachment was downloaded; no local test suite was run in this research pass.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain external-only, advisory, and non-promoting.
